description: v4 only. The individual supplies or borrows inside one v4 spoke: principal, accrued interest and what is withdrawable right now, per item, which the per-spoke aggregate from get_user_positions cannot show. Each item's positionItemId is what a position swap or a repay-with-supply sells, and its 'quotableAs' says which: supplySwapFrom or borrowSwapFrom as get_position_swap_quote's sellPosition, repayDebt as get_repay_with_supply_quote's debtPosition; absent when the item can enter neither. Get 'spokeId' from get_user_positions.

spokeId.description: spokeId from get_user_positions (not the spoke address).

version.description: Optional, and only 'v4': this tool exists on v4 only.

name: get_position_items
title: Get individual position items (v4)
